name: r1_street_nw_unique
js: (async () => { FLIGHT_PROBE.model().grp.visible=false; await new Promise(res => { const t0 = performance.now(); const f = () => { const K = WORLD.premises && WORLD.premises.kit; if ((K && K.status === 'ready' && K.host && !K.host.waiting && K.found >= K.rows.filter(r => !r.out).length) || (K && K.status === 'error') || performance.now() - t0 > 120000) res(1); else setTimeout(f, 250); }; f(); }); WORLD.premises.kitSet('unique'); return 1; })()
report: (() => { const K = WORLD.premises.kit, h = K.host; return JSON.stringify({ mode: K.mode, shown: h && h.visible, status: K.status, err: K.err, rows: K.rows && K.rows.length, found: K.found, hidden: K.hide.size, looks: h && h.stats.looks, waiting: h && h.waiting, slotless: h && h.stats.slotless, rungs: h && h.rungs() }); })()
